<!-- pr-reviewer: d6a54b2bac1aebf74731be557d58c5cfcce5f7cd -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge** (a `feat`: merges at the next cut).

**What looks good**
- No new dependency: Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock untouched; no build.rs, scripts, `.github` or snapshot PNG changes.
- Recents are preference state in `app::recent` plus `State` fields; `OpenRecent`/`ClearRecent` are UI `CommandKind`s like `OpenProjectDialog`, push no history entry, and opening a recent project calls `open_project_path`, so it behaves exactly like a normal Open. `unsaved.rs` gates only existing project files, so a missing file is refused by name before any prompt.
- Corrupt, wrong-format or unreadable file gives an empty list, a `tracing::warn!` and a status line. A missing file starts empty quietly. Writes are atomic (reusing `write_atomic`). Non-UTF8 paths are dropped, not mangled. Relative entries are rejected on load. The cap is clamped to 50.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` in the new non-test code (grep). The config-dir resolver is pure and platform-aware (APPDATA / Application Support / XDG).
- Test isolation: `State::new()` has `recent_store: None`, and only the real shell calls `load_recent`. No test sets the env var, so there is no parallel race and no write to the real user config.
- Layering ui -> app respected; provenance lines and the decision file `docs/decisions/662-recent-files.md` are present; body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #662`.

**Local results (merged with upstream/main - clean, nothing to merge)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| app `recent_files` | 11 pass |
| app `project_roundtrip` | 69 pass |
| app `commands_undo` | 32 pass |
| `camcraft-ui --lib` (includes `recent_door`) | 384 pass, 1 fail: `headless_run_succeeds` (no GPU adapter, environmental) |
| clippy `-p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

```
egui headless run failed: No suitable graphics adapter found
```

**Requested before merge:** none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. `recent.rs` `to_json` falls back to an empty string if serialisation ever failed; `save` would then write an empty file (read back as "corrupt", with a warning). Practically unreachable for this struct, but returning an error from `to_json` would be tidier.
2. `crates/ui/src/state.rs` (3955 lines), `panes.rs` (1511) and `shell.rs` (1632) are far over the 400-line guide and each grew slightly. The new logic was correctly put in new files (`state_recent.rs`, `recent_drop.rs`); just flagging.
3. `RecentFiles::add` canonicalises every existing entry on each add (up to 50 syscalls); fine at this scale.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
